trends.cardDescription: A correlation engine and AI model, evaluate your daily logs and biometric data to find patterns that were hidden.
trends.summaryBody: Two weeks of compounding habits. Meditation cuts evening stress by nearly a third, and sleep is feeding directly into mood.

insights.headline: Meditate 10 min → 28% better mood
insights.body: Days you complete Meditate 10 min tend to have higher mood.

insights.headline: Deep work 90m → 16% higher wellbeing
insights.body: On days with Deep work block (90 min), your wellbeing tends to be higher.

insights.headline: Late screen time → 12% worse next-morning mood
insights.body: Phone use after 22:00 tends to depress next-day mood scores.

methodology.heading: A method, not a vibe.
methodology.subheading: El Portal isn't a template you fill in. Every mechanic answers to three principles that shape the rest of the system.

principles.title: Identity drives behavior.
principles.body: You decide who you want to become. Cycles align around that direction, focusing on the skills and habits your future identity requires. Days keep you consistent.

principles.title: Data collection is essential
principles.body: You can't improve what you don't understand. Track the parts of your life that matter, and build a clearer picture of how you think, work, and live.

principles.title: The system works for you.
principles.body: You do the work. The system analyzes patterns, weighs signals, and surfaces what matters most. A curated tool designed to support your growth, not demand your attention.
